title: Deep-Learning Identification and Global Characterization of Energetic O2+ Beams at Mars
summary: The model identified 36,888 candidate beam intervals, of which 14,484 passed the study quality criteria; retained beams were asymmetric toward the +E hemisphere and varied with solar-wind conditions, while no EUV dependence was apparent. Held-out 20% of 200 manually annotated orbits; macro F1 0.9657 and beam F1 0.9191. The paper notes possible missed weak signals and does not provide independent mission validation.
ai_technology: A U-Net segmented O2+ ion beams in MAVEN spectrograms, enabling event-level global analysis of beam occurrence and energization.
organization: Not stated in the reviewed material
